component.name: Pineapple Notepad
component.summary: 基于 Scintilla 的跨平台文本编辑器

description.p: Pineapple Notepad is an advanced and easy-to-use multi-document text editor. It offers numerous features such as encoding detection and conversion, session recovery, macro recording and much more. It includes a rich set of plain text processing tools and syntax highlighting support for over 300 different file types. It also supports Windows, macOS, and Linux desktop platforms.
菠萝记事本是一款高级、易用的多文档文本编辑器。提供了编码检测、会话恢复、宏录制等诸多功能，内置丰富的纯文本处理工具与超 300 种不同类型文件的语法高亮支持，并且支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux 桌面平台。
